label: SYNTHETIC
note: The pack manifest of the fintech pack (PCK-02, ruling A333; settles the hash-pin of EVD-06, A320). It lists each pack file the core loads with its SHA-256 and names the evidence-mapping id and the reconciliation rule-set id the core expects, so the core hard-codes neither (INV-14). The core loads through it and refuses a mismatch. A path is relative to the pack directory (packs/). `expected` ids are `<id>@<version>` exactly as the file carries them (mapping_id and version, ruleset_id and version). Every file of a listed kind must be listed: an unlisted file is a packcheck failure. Hash-pinned now, signatures later (A320). Any edit to a listed file needs its SHA-256 updated here, in the same pull request: `sha256sum <file>` gives it. The action graphs the pack names (`action_graph_files`) are listed with kind `action_graph`, one entry each (A510, version 2): no graph is served unless it is pinned here, and a pinned graph the pack does not name is refused. Not yet listed (no consumer yet): limits, lexicons, templates, schemas. The injection-screen patterns are listed with kind `injection_patterns`, with `expected.injection_patterns_id` (A645): required, exactly one file, from manifest version 4; a manifest below version 4 lists none or one, and a manifest that lists none carries no pattern data (A664, interim).
